page.overview:
What is Imperial holdouts?

Imperial holdouts, also known as Imperial remnants or as Imperial hideouts, were various fractured political and military remnants of the Galactic Empire which emerged following its collapse and prevailed throughout the first few years of the New Republic Era.

Without a ruler to hold them together after the death of the Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine during the Galactic Civil War, who left behind no instructions of succession, the Empire began to fragment across the galaxy, while the Imperial Navy retreated as the Alliance to Restore the Republic reorganized into the New Republic. The Battle of Jakku saw the final defeat of the Empire, forcing a surrender to the New Republic.

With strict disarmament treaties and reparations in place following the signing of the Galactic Concordance, the Empire collapsed as a unified polity. Chancellor Mon Mothma also issuing a further declaration designating members of the Imperial Military as war criminals while granting conditional pardons to non-combatant functionaries. Following this, many of its soldiers, officials, warlords and other holdouts fled to the fringes of the galaxy.

By 9 ABY, Imperial holdouts remained active in the galaxy with one faction lead by Moff Gideon being active in the Outer Rim Territories on planets like Nevarro During this time, Gideon and his remnant sought after the Force-sensitive child Grogu as part of their cloning experiments and succeeded in capturing him on Tython, but was later rescued by the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his allies that saw Moff Gideon arrested and brought into New Republic custody afterwards.
